case_title: MARTINEZ, GILBERT VS BEVERAGES & MORE ATT:DOUG CERVANTES MANAGER

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $452.76 FILED BY MARTINEZ, GILBERT AS TO DEFENDANT BEVERAGES & MORE  ATT:DOUG CERVANTES MANAGER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-18-1999 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERTIFIED MAIL TO DOUG CERVANTES, MGR. BEVERAGES & MORE RETURNED SIGNED;

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MARTINEZ, GILBERT IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BEVERAGES & MORE  ATT:DOUG CERVANTES MANAGER EACH SIDE TO BEAR THEIR OWN COSTS. PLFT. DID NOT PROVE AND NO EVIDENCE DEMONSTRATED, THAT HIS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
